Does a card with a 24px radius clip a full-width image child on a group (module.decoration is the card's own element)? PASS only if the child image's corners are clipped (the card gets overflow hidden); otherwise recorded DEAD for the clip with the reason. The image is the first child, so its top corners touch the card's. Also read the card's computed overflow in changedProps. RESULT (separate pixel check, Docker site, Divi 5.15.1, 1280 and 400 px): writing a radius makes Divi print overflow:hidden on the group (computed overflow visible -> hidden, radius 24px), and a full-width image that touches the card's top-left corner is clipped: the screenshot pixel 2px inside the corner is white (the page) with the radius and the image's blue without it, on both widths. The probe's computed-style diff shows the card's overflow-x/overflow-y/overflow-block/overflow-inline change. The image's own border-radius stays 0px: the clip is the card's, not a radius on the child. Side effect: overflow:hidden also clips anything of a child that spills out of the card.
